flags.name: path-id
flags.summary: The ID or URL-encoded path of the group owned by the authenticated user.

flags.name: query-author-id
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`.

flags.name: query-author-username
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.

flags.name: query-assignee-id
flags.summary: Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee.

flags.name: query-assignee-username
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.

flags.name: query-reviewer-username
flags.summary: Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`. Introduced in GitLab 13.8.

flags.name: query-labels
flags.summary: Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.

flags.name: query-milestone
flags.summary: Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.

flags.name: query-my-reaction-emoji
flags.summary: Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.

flags.name: query-reviewer-id
flags.summary: Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`.

flags.name: query-state
flags.summary: Returns `all` merge requests or just those that are `opened`, `closed`, `locked`, or `merged`.

flags.name: query-order-by
flags.summary: Returns merge requests ordered by `created_at`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `title`, `updated_at` or `merged_at` fields. Introduced in GitLab 14.8.

flags.name: query-sort
flags.summary: Returns merge requests sorted in `asc` or `desc` order.

flags.name: query-with-labels-details
flags.summary: If `true`, response returns more details for each label in labels field: `:name`,`:color`, `:description`, `:description_html`, `:text_color`

flags.name: query-with-merge-status-recheck
flags.summary: If `true`, this projection requests (but does not guarantee) that the `merge_status` field be recalculated asynchronously. Introduced in GitLab 13.0.

flags.name: query-created-after
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

flags.name: query-created-before
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

flags.name: query-updated-after
flags.summary: Returns merge requests updated on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

flags.name: query-updated-before
flags.summary: Returns merge requests updated on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

flags.name: query-scope
flags.summary: Returns merge requests for the given scope: `created_by_me`, `assigned_to_me`, `reviews_for_me` or `all`

flags.name: query-source-branch
flags.summary: Returns merge requests with the given source branch

flags.name: query-source-project-id
flags.summary: Returns merge requests with the given source project id

flags.name: query-target-branch
flags.summary: Returns merge requests with the given target branch

flags.name: query-search
flags.summary: Search merge requests against their `title` and `description`.

flags.name: query-in
flags.summary: Modify the scope of the search attribute. `title`, `description`, or a string joining them with comma.

flags.name: query-wip
flags.summary: Deprecated. Use `draft` instead. Filter merge requests against their `wip` status. `yes` to return only draft merge requests, `no` to return non-draft merge requests.

flags.name: query-draft
flags.summary: Filter merge requests against their `draft` status. `true` to return only draft merge requests, `false` to return non-draft merge requests.

flags.name: query-not-author-id
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`.

flags.name: query-not-author-username
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.

flags.name: query-not-assignee-id
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee.

flags.name: query-not-assignee-username
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.

flags.name: query-not-reviewer-username
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`. Introduced in GitLab 13.8.

flags.name: query-not-labels
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.

flags.name: query-not-milestone
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.

flags.name: query-not-my-reaction-emoji

flags.name: path-id

flags.name: query-author-id
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`.

flags.name: query-author-username
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.

flags.name: query-assignee-id
flags.summary: Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee.

flags.name: query-assignee-username
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.

flags.name: query-reviewer-username
flags.summary: Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`. Introduced in GitLab 13.8.

flags.name: query-labels
flags.summary: Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.

flags.name: query-milestone
flags.summary: Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.

flags.name: query-my-reaction-emoji
flags.summary: Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.

flags.name: query-reviewer-id
flags.summary: Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`.

flags.name: query-state
flags.summary: Returns `all` merge requests or just those that are `opened`, `closed`, `locked`, or `merged`.

flags.name: query-order-by
flags.summary: Returns merge requests ordered by `created_at`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `title`, `updated_at` or `merged_at` fields. Introduced in GitLab 14.8.

flags.name: query-sort
flags.summary: Returns merge requests sorted in `asc` or `desc` order.

flags.name: query-with-labels-details
flags.summary: If `true`, response returns more details for each label in labels field: `:name`,`:color`, `:description`, `:description_html`, `:text_color`

flags.name: query-with-merge-status-recheck
flags.summary: If `true`, this projection requests (but does not guarantee) that the `merge_status` field be recalculated asynchronously. Introduced in GitLab 13.0.

flags.name: query-created-after
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

flags.name: query-created-before
flags.summary: Returns merge requests created on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

flags.name: query-updated-after
flags.summary: Returns merge requests updated on or after the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

flags.name: query-updated-before
flags.summary: Returns merge requests updated on or before the given time. Expected in ISO 8601 format.

flags.name: query-scope
flags.summary: Returns merge requests for the given scope: `created_by_me`, `assigned_to_me`, `reviews_for_me` or `all`

flags.name: query-source-branch
flags.summary: Returns merge requests with the given source branch

flags.name: query-source-project-id
flags.summary: Returns merge requests with the given source project id

flags.name: query-target-branch
flags.summary: Returns merge requests with the given target branch

flags.name: query-search
flags.summary: Search merge requests against their `title` and `description`.

flags.name: query-in
flags.summary: Modify the scope of the search attribute. `title`, `description`, or a string joining them with comma.

flags.name: query-wip
flags.summary: Deprecated. Use `draft` instead. Filter merge requests against their `wip` status. `yes` to return only draft merge requests, `no` to return non-draft merge requests.

flags.name: query-draft
flags.summary: Filter merge requests against their `draft` status. `true` to return only draft merge requests, `false` to return non-draft merge requests.

flags.name: query-not-author-id
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`.

flags.name: query-not-author-username
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.

flags.name: query-not-assignee-id
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee.

flags.name: query-not-assignee-username
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.

flags.name: query-not-reviewer-username
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`. Introduced in GitLab 13.8.

flags.name: query-not-labels
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.

flags.name: query-not-milestone
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.

flags.name: query-not-my-reaction-emoji
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.

flags.name: query-not-reviewer-id
flags.summary: `<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`.
